title: Devis IA — AI-assisted construction quotes

information.value: Kévin BOYER-NAVARRO — solo design and development
Voice or text job descriptions / AI-assisted quote preparation / Editable quote items / Net, VAT and gross totals / PDF export / Client management / Follow-up and subscription settings

description: Devis IA is an entrepreneurial project that I design and develop on my own. Its goal is to speed up quote preparation for construction professionals and reduce time spent on administration, allowing them to focus more on their jobs and clients.

The idea is simple: a tradesperson describes the planned work, by speaking or typing, and AI helps structure an initial quote. They can then review and adjust the items, quantities, prices and VAT before producing a professional PDF.

The prototype brings together a dashboard, client management, company details and payment terms, along with settings for follow-ups and subscription plans. These features support the development of a service for tradespeople and construction businesses.
The gallery follows the user journey: sign in, introduction and home, first quote creation, item editing, quote summary and PDF preview, followed by clients, settings, follow-ups and subscriptions.
